Create a complete modern, responsive Arabic (RTL) website UI for a platform called “DZ LAW HUB”.

Main goals:
- Provide legal AI consultation in Algerian dialect
- Help law students: lessons, flashcards, quizzes, research topics
- Simple for general citizens to learn their legal rights

-------------------------------------
Global Design
-------------------------------------
- Modern minimal UI, blue accents (#3A7CEB)
- Rounded cards, clean spacing, icons for law & AI
- Fully RTL Arabic typography
- Chatbot floating button included
- Add placeholder section for chatbot script:
  <script chatbot_id="6920389acf9f089c5c43c5e8" data-type="default"></script>

-------------------------------------
Pages & Sections
-------------------------------------

1️⃣ Homepage
- Hero title: “DZ LAW HUB – منصتك القانونية الجزائرية”
- Subtitle: “ذكاء اصطناعي + دروس + بطاقات + اختبارات”
- CTAs:
  • ابدأ الاستشارة
  • دروس القانون
- Feature boxes:
  • Legal AI Assistant
  • Lessons (3 years)
  • Flashcards
  • Quizzes

2️⃣ AI Assistant Page
- Chat UI like: messages bubbles, input field bottom
- Placeholder text: “اكتب سؤالك القانوني…”
- Notice: “يرجى التأكد من النص واستشارة مختص”
- Floating chatbot also remains globally

3️⃣ Lessons Page
Tabs:
- سنة أولى – سنة ثانية – سنة ثالثة
Each lesson card has:
- Summary
- Key points
- Examples
- Exam questions
- Button: “فسّرلي أكثر يا الذكاء الاصطناعي”

4️⃣ Flashcards Page
- Grid of flip cards
- Front: المصطلح
- Back: تعريف + رقم المادة

5️⃣ Quizzes Page
Quiz categories:
- Criminal – Civil – Family – Commercial – Administrative
Result popup after answering
Progress tracking

6️⃣ Research Topics Page
Grid cards:
- Title + short description + “اقترح خطة بحث”

-------------------------------------
Extra Features
-------------------------------------
- Student dashboard
- Dark mode switch
- Saved flashcards & progress
- Search bar for all legal topics
- Weekly skill challenges

-------------------------------------
For Investors
-------------------------------------
Show monetization UI space:
- Premium features
- University partnerships
- Advertisement slots

-------------------------------------
For Tech4Law Club
-------------------------------------
Dedicated section:
- “Powered by Tech4Law Club”
- Community showcase and collaboration benefits

-------------------------------------
Footer
-------------------------------------
- About
- Contact
- Privacy
- “Powered by AI Legal Engine – DZ LAW HUB”

**Developing the Framework**

Okay, I'm making headway on the structure. I've successfully mapped the user's requirements for a complete, modern React application. It's clear that it has to be Arabic (RTL) and revolve around Algerian legal AI consultation and resources for law students. The goal is to design a solid foundation that can house these components effectively.


**Outlining Feature Integration**

I'm now integrating the features into the architecture. The recent focus is on the specific components: home, AI assistant, lessons, flashcards, quizzes, and research topics. I've broken each down into its core functionalities and considered data visualization, and user engagement strategies (e.g. quizzes, flashcards). I'm also addressing the extra requirements like dark mode and the student dashboard, all with RTL direction and rounded cards in mind.


**Detailing Project Structure**

I'm presently building out the project structure, and I've now specified all the file and directory names.  I'm focusing on the `App.tsx` router, the data structures in `types.ts`, and the mock data within `constants.ts`.  I've also defined the reusable UI components like the layout and the AI modal. Finally, I've got a comprehensive listing of all of the page components and their files.


**Building Core Elements**

I've just added the `dir="rtl"` attribute and chosen an Arabic font within the HTML, ensuring proper text direction. Next, I defined the crucial data structures in `types.ts`, and I'm currently creating the authentic Arabic mock data in `constants.ts`, focusing on Algerian legal context. The foundation for my GenAI service is being implemented in `geminiService.ts`, and I'm using `createRoot` for the entry point in `index.tsx`. My `App.tsx` file now manages the routing using a HashRouter, along with a Layout incorporating the Navbar, Footer, and a Dark Mode toggle.


**Incorporating the Dashboard**

I've begun building the dashboard. My current focus is implementing charts using Recharts.  I'm now also refining several essential details.  I'm ensuring correct RTL support in `index.html` by adding `dir="rtl"`.  I'm also setting up the appropriate icons using `lucide-react`, and I'm configuring the AI integration, designing the `AIResponseModal` component. Finally, I'm integrating the chatbot script into `index.html`. My chosen theme has a blue accent, and I'm updating my Tailwind configuration.


**Addressing Algerian Context**

Now, I'm integrating the Algerian dialect into the AI prompts. I'm adding a specific system instruction within the Gemini chat configuration to ensure responses use Algerian Darja or suitable Arabic for Algerian legal topics. I'm also ensuring the correct Google Font, "Cairo," is incorporated for a modern Arabic display. On a coding level, I'm working out the flashcard flip logic, using click-based mobile interaction rather than hover, and a simple array-based structure for quiz questions and answers. Error handling for the API key in the Gemini integration is also a priority.


**Adding Monetization Section**

I'm now integrating a monetization section in the dashboard, considering an investor section. I'm building out the XML structure, including all project files. I've switched the model used by `geminiService` to `gemini-2.5-flash` and am adjusting the import. Finally, I'll ensure stylistic consistency, making sure all text is understandable in Arabic.
